tokens.description: Raised surface above the default layer (popovers, dropdowns, dialogs). Not for inline card surfaces.

tokens.description: Primary body and heading text. Not for secondary, placeholder, or disabled text.

tokens.description: Error, danger, or destructive action text and icons, on a neutral surface or on a destructive tint. Not for general warning or informational text.

docs.description: Destructive or error-state text and icons — the class `text-destructive`. Darker than `color.feedback.error.default` in light mode and lighter in dark mode, so it stays at 4.5:1 or more on every surface and on the `bg-destructive/10`–`/30` tints.

tokens.description: Viewport width from which the `sm:` variant applies (mobile-first, min-width). Not a container width.
Viewport width from which the `md:` variant applies (mobile-first, min-width). Not a container width.
Viewport width from which the `lg:` variant applies (mobile-first, min-width). Not a container width.
Viewport width from which the `xl:` variant applies (mobile-first, min-width). No component needs it yet; Tailwind compiles it regardless, so the token keeps its value on record for wide layouts.
Viewport width from which the `2xl:` variant applies (mobile-first, min-width). No component needs it yet; Tailwind compiles it regardless, so the token keeps its value on record for wide layouts.
Width of every plain border: `border`, `border-t`, `divide-x`… Not for focus rings, which use space.focus-ring-width.
Stroke of the dashed series indicator in chart tooltips. Not for component borders.
Ring painted in the background color around an element that overlaps another, cutting it out: stacked avatars, an avatar's badge. Not for borders or focus rings.
shadcn --background compatibility alias. Maps the semantic default surface to the shadcn variable name expected by shadcn/ui components.
shadcn --foreground compatibility alias. Maps primary text color to the shadcn variable name.
shadcn --card compatibility alias. Cards use the subtle surface (slightly off-white / dark mist) rather than pure default to create visual separation.
shadcn --card-foreground compatibility alias. Reuses default text color for card content.
shadcn --popover compatibility alias. Popovers use the elevated surface token to convey depth above the page.
shadcn --popover-foreground compatibility alias. Reuses default text color for popover content.
shadcn --primary compatibility alias. Maps the brand action background to the shadcn primary slot.
shadcn --primary-foreground compatibility alias. Maps the on-action foreground to the shadcn primary-foreground slot.
shadcn --secondary compatibility alias. The secondary variant shares the subtle surface token rather than a palette of its own.
shadcn --secondary-foreground compatibility alias. Secondary text uses default text color for legibility.
shadcn --muted compatibility alias. Muted areas share the subtle surface token.
shadcn --muted-foreground compatibility alias. Muted foreground maps to the semantic subtle text token.
shadcn --accent compatibility alias. Accent hover states share the subtle surface token with muted areas.
shadcn --accent-foreground compatibility alias. Accent foreground uses default text for contrast.
shadcn --destructive compatibility alias. Maps the semantic error token to the shadcn destructive slot.
shadcn --destructive-foreground compatibility alias. Text and icons on a solid destructive surface.
shadcn --border compatibility alias. Maps the semantic default border to the shadcn border slot.
shadcn --input compatibility alias. Maps the semantic input border to the shadcn input slot for form field outlines.
shadcn --ring compatibility alias. Maps the semantic focus ring to the shadcn ring slot.
shadcn --radius compatibility alias. Maps to radius.lg (= radius.base = 0.625rem), the canonical border-radius used across shadcn components.
shadcn --chart-1 compatibility alias. Maps the semantic chart series 1 token.
shadcn --chart-2 compatibility alias. Maps the semantic chart series 2 token.
shadcn --chart-3 compatibility alias. Maps the semantic chart series 3 token.
shadcn --chart-4 compatibility alias. Maps the semantic chart series 4 token.
shadcn --chart-5 compatibility alias. Maps the semantic chart series 5 token.
shadcn --sidebar compatibility alias. Maps the semantic sidebar background token.
shadcn --sidebar-foreground compatibility alias. Maps the semantic sidebar foreground token.
shadcn --sidebar-primary compatibility alias. Maps the active/primary sidebar item color.
shadcn --sidebar-primary-foreground compatibility alias. Maps the on-primary sidebar text; the name mismatch (primary-foreground vs primary.on) is why this bridge is needed.
shadcn --sidebar-accent compatibility alias. Maps the sidebar hover/accent surface token.
shadcn --sidebar-accent-foreground compatibility alias. Maps the sidebar accent text token.
shadcn --sidebar-border compatibility alias. Maps the sidebar border token.
shadcn --sidebar-ring compatibility alias. Maps the sidebar focus ring token.
